# CI Badge

Paste these lines into the top of the repo README.md (replace `OWNER` with your GitHub username):

```markdown
[![CI](https://github.com/OWNER/synapse/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/OWNER/synapse/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
```

For the badge with branch filter (shows only the `main` branch status):

```markdown
[![CI](https://github.com/OWNER/synapse/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/OWNER/synapse/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
```
